sentences.text:
Shri B.S. Kushwaha - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Raghuwar Prajapati - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.94/2024 dated 19.2.2024 registered at Police Station -Bairasia, District Bhopal for the offence under Sections 363, 366A, 344,376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3/4, 5 L and 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is aged about 19 years having no criminal past.
An affidavit, contained in Annexure A-3, reflects that the prosecutrix and applicant have entered into wedlock.

This aspect has been taken note of by this Court while allowing the bail of co-accused Radha, who is mother of the applicant vide order dated 31.5.2024 in M.Cr.C No.
18696/2024.
Therefore, the applicant who has no criminal past and is in custody since 21.3.2024 deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that considering the nature of allegation, no case for grant NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:40533 2 MCRC-31459-2024 of bail is made out.
4. Considering the totality of the circumstances and also the fact that the applicant and prosecutrix have entered into wedlock, this Court deem it fit to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the Yuvraj Kanjar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193717439/
1 application is allowed.

sentences.text:
5. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned their appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
6.

It is further directed that the applicants shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
